scaffold.name: 4-anilinoquinazoline
scaffold.story: The core that erlotinib and gefitinib share. The quinazoline N1 accepts a hydrogen bond from the Met769 hinge; everything else is decoration hung off two vectors that point in opposite directions.

vectors.label: Aniline meta position
vectors.note: Past the Thr766 gatekeeper sits a small, greasy cavity lined by Lys721 and Leu694. Small hydrophobic groups gain affinity here; anything bulky runs into the gatekeeper.
vectors.hint: Reward for greasy and slim. Punish for wide.

vectors.label: Quinazoline 6-position
vectors.points: out of the cleft toward solvent
vectors.note: This vector leaves the ATP site entirely. Affinity is fairly insensitive to what you hang here, which makes it the place to fix solubility, add a basic amine, or park a linker.
vectors.hint: Cheap real estate. Spend polarity here, not in the back pocket.

H|H.name: Bare core
H|H.note: the scaffold with nothing hung off it

Cl|MPO.name: Gefitinib-like
Cl|MPO.note: gefitinib carries a 3-Cl-4-F aniline; this is the closest analog on these vectors
